name: branch-status-mod
description: Pane listing the branches and worktrees that run parallel to main - commits ahead and behind, merged or not (squash merges included, via the PR), and their open PRs with checks and review

showPrs.title: Show pull requests
showPrs.description: Ask GitHub (gh) for each branch's PR: number, checks, review and merged state. Off, merges are seen by git alone, so a squash merge is not recognised.

prRefreshMinutes.title: PR refresh (minutes)
prRefreshMinutes.description: How often PRs are fetched from GitHub. They are also fetched after a gh command or git push, and when /branches runs.
